According to the UK Child Benefit rules, to be eligible you must meet UK residency requirements, which include:

- Normally living in the UK, OR
- Having settled status under the EU Settlement Scheme, OR

📞 **Child Benefit Helpline:** 0300 200 3100
🌐 **More information:** https://www.gov.uk/child-benefit/eligibility

They will be able to assess your immigration status and advise you on whether you meet the residency requirements for Child Benefit.
